==Other Appearances==
{{Main|Ganon/Other Appearances}}
Ganon is also featured in other media, including comics based on the games, animated shows, and the {{SSB Series}}. Although his appearance varies from the main series, Ganon is still the wielder of the Triforce of Power who seeks to rule Hyrule by using the power of the sacred relic, fighting against Princess Zelda and Link to reach his goal. Ganon also appeared in ''[[nookipedia:Animal Crossing: New Leaf|Animal Crossing: New Leaf]]''. He can be summoned through Wisp by using the Ganondorf, Bokoblin, or 8-Bit Link amiibo.

==Trivia==
*Due to a glitch, it is possible to defeat Ganon in {{ALttP}} with the [[Master Sword]] instead of [[Silver Arrow]]s.{{Clarify}}
*In {{TWW|-}}, according to the original Japanese text, the Master Sword was not only sealing his magic, but also his minions, as can be observed in-game.<ref name="Magic Seal"/><ref>{{Cite|その剣は、魔を撃退する{{Color TWW|Vermilion|退魔の剣}} であると同時に、 我が魔族を封じていた、いまいましい{{Color TWW|Vermilion|封印}} そのものなのだよ！|translation= That sword is the {{Color TWW|Vermilion|Anti-Demon Sword}} that repels demons. However, it is also the annoying {{Color TWW|Vermilion|seal}} that was sealing my demon tribe.|Ganondorf|TWW|lang= ja}} <small>(Translation by [http://forums.legendsalliance.com/topic/14202-translation-of-japanese-game-texts/page-27#entry404295 jacensolo06])</small></ref>
*The shape of Ganondorf's ears have varied throughout the series. His initial appearance in {{OoT|-}}'s child timeline depicts him with rounded ears. After the time gap in which he was able to obtain the Triforce of Power, his ears become more pointed, similar to those of Hylians. This detail was removed in {{OoT3D|-}}. Ganondorf retains his pointed ears in {{TWW|-}} and {{TP|-}}.
*In {{OoT|-}}, Ganon plays his own theme on a pipe organ. In {{TP|-}}, a similar effect occurs when Link progresses through Hyrule Castle, as the background music shifts from the Hyrule Castle theme to Ganon's theme. This makes Ganondorf one of a handful of characters to generate their own theme music; the others being Midna, Ghirahim, Yuga and Madame Couture, all of whom hum their themes.
*Early artwork for {{OoS|-}} and {{OoA|-}} shows [[:File:OoS Ganondorf Concept Artwork.png|a design for Ganondorf]], implying he was originally planned to appear in the games. According to the notes for the artwork, the image was meant to depict Ganondorf's phantom.
*According to the {{HH|-}}, Ganondorf is a whopping 230 cm tall (7'6<nowiki>''</nowiki>) in {{OoT|-}}.<ref name="HH 148">{{Cite Book|quote= |book=HH|page= 148}}</ref> His 1/4 scale model from [[First 4 Figures]], who used in game data to faithfully recreate his appearance in {{TP|-}}, stands at 23 inches tall, which indicates that he also stands at 7'6<nowiki>''</nowiki> in that game as well.<ref>[https://www.first4figures.com/ganondorf.html Ganondorf's First 4 Figures Exclusive Figure]</ref>
*[[Fierce Deity Link]] in {{MM}} appears to be the same height as Ganondorf.
*[[Topaz]] is Ganondorf's favorite gemstone. In {{OoT|-}} he decorates his armor and weapons with them.<ref name="HH 148"/><ref name="E 21"/>
*Prior to the battle with Dark Beast Ganon in {{BotW|-}}, Zelda states that Ganon has given up on reincarnation to fight in his "pure, enraged form."<ref name="Pure"/> However, the dialogue in the Japanese version appears to contradict this, as Zelda says that the form was born from his obsessive refusal to give up on revival.<ref>{{Cite Web|quote= This form was born from his obsessive refusal to give up on revival… |published= August 11, 2017 |retrieved= February 22, 2018 |url= https://legendsoflocalization.com/breath-of-the-wilds-ganon-in-english-japanese/ |title= How Ganon’s Motivation Changed in Breath of the Wild’s English Translation }}</ref>
*Originally, Ganondorf when defeated in {{TP|-}} gave a speech where he indicated Zelda and Link, and any who bore the marks of the Triforce of Wisdom and Courage, respectively, are inevitably going to enter conflict with their opponent like Ganondorf due to it being pre-ordained by the Gods, and an era of bloodshed would come to Hyrule.<ref name="Cut dialogue">{{Cite Web|quote= 選ばれし力を持つ者が現れる時<br />必ず、その対極を成す者が生まれ出ん<br />それが、お前達が信じる神が与えた<br />紋章を持つ者の運命だ<br />この世に紋章を持つ者が現れる限り<br />何度でも、流血の時代が訪れる|translation= When one appears bearing the chosen power, so shall their antithesis invariably come into being. That is the destiny of those who bear the crests granted by the gods in which you believe. Each time a crest-bearer appears in this world, an era of bloodshed ever shall follow.|author= |title= The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess/Unused Text - The Cutting Room Floor|url= https://tcrf.net/The_Legend_of_Zelda:_Twilight_Princess/Unused_Text#Ganondorf|archive= |published= |retrieved= August 25, 2024|site= TCRF}}</ref> This was largely excised in the final version, where Ganondorf instead merely assured them that their conflict would not end then and that it was "the beginning of a history of blood-drenched struggle between light and darkness".{{Note|The official English translation of the line, "The history of light and shadow will
be written in blood!", has a critical mistake that interprets the word "blood" as a metaphor for genetic traits instead of bloodsheds that suggests intense violence and deaths}} Demise's curse at the end of Skyward Sword resembled this cut speech.
*The designer and modeler of Ganondorf in {{OoT|-}}, [[Satoru Takizawa]], mentioned the design process of Ganondorf as "At first, I imagined him as a twisted-minded man who has insecurities and holds a strong grudge yet is servile", and he drew a concept design based on it, but the team that designed non-hostile characters and script director [[Toru Osawa]] told him that it does not fit their vision and Ganondorf needs to be fine-looking, like Raoh from the comic ''{{Wp|Fist of the North Star}}'', a handsome and charismatic big bad. Takizawa used actor {{Wp|Christopher Lambert}} as a reference to form the design for the final model of Ganondorf, but he thinks the models ended up not much resembling the actor.<ref>{{Cite Web|quote= ぼくが最初に考えたガノンは、すごい歪んだ、コンプレックスを抱いている盗賊で、卑屈な人間だ、というイメージを持っていて、だからそういう設定にして持っていったんだけれども、キャラクターデザインチームやスクリプト担当の大澤さんは「そうではない」と。今回のガノンはかなりいいオトコや、と。『北斗の拳』でいうと、ラオウみたいなもんや。もっといいおニイさんで、しかもカリスマ的大物っぷりを発揮させたい、というので、それで作り直しました。|author= |title= ほぼ日刊イトイ新聞 - 樹の上の秘密基地|url= https://www.1101.com/nintendo/nin1/nin1-6.htm|archive= |published= |retrieved= August 25, 2024|site= www.1101.com|type= }}</ref> According to Takizawa, the concept of Ganondorf's clothes is the 80's glam rock and "a heavy metal dude". He also mentioned that Osawa requested that he use red, black, and gold for Ganondorf.<ref>{{Cite Web|quote= 衣装の設定は、80年代のビジュアル系ロックバンドですかね。メタル兄ちゃん、みたいな（笑）。ガノンドロフは砂漠の民だっていう認識があって、イメージとしては、大澤さんから「今回は赤と黒と金や」って言われていたので、その色を念頭においてます。（キャラクターデザイン・滝沢　智さん）|author= |title= ほぼ日刊イトイ新聞 - 樹の上の秘密基地|url= https://www.1101.com/nintendo/nin1/nin1-13.htm|archive= |published= |retrieved= August 25, 2024|site= www.1101.com|type= }}</ref>
** After Ganondorf's design was finalized, artist [[Yusuke Nakano]] drew the first artwork of Ganondorf with wide-open eyes, like he might have been a little mad. Takizawa requested Nakano make Ganondorf's eye expression look more clever to tell he is more than a brute, a man of high caliber. He also pointed out that the official artwork of Ganondorf done by Nakano looks way more muscular than he imagined, as he thought Ganondorf was capable of quick yet graceful moves, and Nakano admitted that he exaggerated the muscles more than was necessary because it was his style.<ref>{{Cite Book|book= A&A|page= 413}}</ref>
** The director of {{TotK|-}}, [[Hidemaro Fujibayashi]], mentioned the design direction of Ganondorf {{TotK|-}}, which is similar to what is done in {{OoT}}, as the designer tried to embody a man who is "extremely evil but also physically appealing, everyone finds him fascinating" instead of just looking violent, and Ganondorf's clothes and accessories were also carefully designed to show his nobility and intelligence since he was supposed to have a keen eye for aesthetics and a good sense of clothing as a king.<ref>{{Cite Web|quote= ――　見た目も本当にカッコいいです。<br />藤林　ありがとうございます。しっかりビジュアルで表現できたと思っています。担当デザイナーも、単に暴力的なだけでなく、圧倒的な悪でありつつ、男性も女性も惚れるイイ男にしたいという思いを体現したと言ってます。服装やアクセサリーの選びかたも大事にしていて、ガノンドロフ本人が美的意識が高くセンスがよいという設定を意識しています。身だしなみにもちゃんと気を配れる、王としての気品や知性が出ているキャラクターだろうということを考えてデザインしていて、顔、体、指の先まですべてのパーツにこだわって、屈強さとセクシーさを併せ持つイメージに仕上げています。|url= https://www.ndw.jp/totk-interview-231026/3/|archive= |published= |retrieved= August 25, 2024|site= Nintendo DREAM WEB|type= }}</ref>
*Ganon's roars in the final battle of {{OoT|-}}, alongside [[Volvagia]]'s, are a faster and higher-pitched edit of [[Queen Gohma]]'s roar.
*In the original N64 version of {{OoT|-}} (1.0 or 1.1), Ganondorf can be seen coughing red blood when defeated, as well as during when Link stabbed him in the mouth for the finishing blow in his beast form. In later 1.2 releases and the 3DS remake, it was changed to green and the Master Sword now hits Ganon in the forehead to make it less violent and prevent the risk of increasing the game's rating.
*Ganon's boar-like form was based on Zhu Bajie, one of the characters from the Chinese novel ''Journey to the West''. In fact, during development of the first Zelda game, Ganon was originally going to be named Hakkai, the Japanese transliteration of Zhu Bajie.<ref>https://archive.today/20120629063241/http://www.nintendo.co.uk/NOE/en_GB/news/iwata/iwata_asks_-_zelda_handheld_history_15603_15604.html</ref>
